params.name: user_guid
params.description: The unique identifier for a `user`, beginning with the prefix `USR-`.

items.docs: Calling this endpoint initiates an aggregation-type event which will gather the member's rewards information, as well as account and transaction information. Rewards data is also gathered with daily background aggregations. Member and Rewards guids are defined by MX.

params.name: reward_guid
params.description: The unique identifier for the rewards. Defined by MX.

items.docs: Use this endpoint to read a specific `reward` based on its unique GUID. Member and Rewards guids are defined by MX.

params.name: credit_card_product_guid
params.description: The required `credit_card_product_guid` can be found on the `account` object.

items.docs: This endpoint returns the specified `credit_card_product` according to the unique GUID.
